text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Tender (RFT) for the Construction of the Polar Bear Life Support System (LSS) and Redirection of Tundra Trail Project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the award of Request for Tender (RFT) 70 for the Construction of the Polar Bear Life Support System (LSS) and Redirection of Tundra Trail Project to Pine Valley Corporation in the amount of $1,874,416.70.
